Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sensor

Class RowSensor

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.observer.AbstractObservable
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sensor.RowSensor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Observable, Observer, Serializable
public class RowSensor extends AbstractObservable implements Observer
Aggregated occupancy sensor for a whole row.

A row sensor is both an Observer of its seat sensors and an Observable: whenever one of its seats changes, it recomputes the row's occupancy and notifies its own observers with a ROW_OCCUPANCY_CHANGED event. This gives the supervisor a live, row-level view of how full the venue is.
